uncertainties: Manufacturer, datasheet reference, power domain, clock sources and wiring source are not yet attached for any chip.
F133 to D213 boot path and link ownership are unconfirmed (spec 13.2).
F133 to 12F and F133 to D213 interconnects are not described; only the proposed D213 to 45F RGMII link is recorded.
HDMI transmitter and stereo HDMI audio support are unconfirmed.
USB-A/USB-C host port allocation is ambiguous.
The four memory pools (about 228 MiB total) are independent; there is no unified address space.
